API overview

This page maps the public API of each crate. For full signatures and doc comments, see docs.rs.

CrateImport asdocs.rs
merkle-coremerkle_coredocs.rs/merkle-core
merkleforge-hashmerkleforge_hashdocs.rs/merkleforge-hash
merkle-variantsmerkle_variantsdocs.rs/merkle-variants

docs.rs shows the latest published release (0.4.1). Items marked Unreleased below are in the repository but not yet on crates.io.

merkle-core

Traits, types, and errors shared by every crate. no_std + alloc capable (details).

merkle_core::prelude

Re-exports MerkleError, HashFunction, MerkleTree, ProofVerifier, Serializable, LeafIndex, MerkleProof, NodeIndex, ProofNode, ProofSide, and TreeMetadata.

use merkle_core::prelude::*;
 
fn main() {
    let index = LeafIndex(3);
    assert_eq!(index.value(), 3);
    assert_eq!(NodeIndex::from(index), NodeIndex(3));
    assert_eq!(NodeIndex::root(4), NodeIndex(6)); // [L0 L1 L2 L3 P01 P23 Root]
}

merkleforge-hash

ItemDescription
Sha256SHA-256 with 0x00/0x01 domain prefixes
Keccak256Keccak-256 with 0x00/0x01 prefixes; plain Keccak for Patricia nodes
Blake3BLAKE3 derive_key with leaf and internal-node contexts
HashFunctionRe-export of merkle_core::traits::HashFunction

All three are zero-sized, Copy, and produce [u8; 32]. See Hash functions.

merkle-variants

Top-level re-exports: BinaryMerkleTree, SparseMerkleTree, MerklePatriciaTrie, MptProof.

binary — BinaryMerkleTree<H>

MethodNotes
new(), with_capacity(n), DefaultEmpty tree
from_leaves(iter)One-pass O(n) build (Unreleased)
insert(&[u8]) -> Result<LeafIndex>Append a leaf
remove(LeafIndex)Replace with H::empty()
root(), leaf_count(), is_empty(), height()Queries
generate_proof(LeafIndex) -> Result<MerkleProof>Inclusion proof
verify(root, leaf, &proof) -> boolStateless, associated function

Implements MerkleTree<H>, ProofVerifier<H>; Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize (Unreleased). Guide: Binary Merkle tree.

generate_membership_proof(key) -> Result<SparseMerkleProof>Membership or non-membership
verify_membership(root, key, leaf, &proof)Checks key, value, path (Unreleased)
verify_non_membership(root, key, &proof)Absence proof

empty_hash_at(level), empty_hashes()Empty-subtree cache
stored_node_count(), last_node_access_count(), unbatched_node_count_estimate()Storage introspection

Also: SparseMerkleProof<D> (key, siblings, leaf; is_membership(), is_non_membership()), NodeEntry<D> (with commitment(), Unreleased), SubtreeBatch<D>, bit_at, and the constants SPARSE_TREE_DEPTH, EMPTY_HASH_LEVELS, BATCH_DEPTH. Guide: Sparse Merkle tree.
